rationale: wu_2015-claude-agentic: wu_n_bands=6, wu_n_outer=0, wu_motion_range=8, wu_motion_window=2, wu_soft_thresh=0.0015, val_n=200, val_chunk=4, seed=42, rationale=ITER-2 (one knob vs iter-1). NUMBERS: iter-1 hr=0.0 (n_outer=2): Wu recon val_ssim=0.469 PSNR=22.80 RMSE=0.0247, but the plain FBP baseline is ssim=0.920 PSNR=36.32 RMSE=0.00521 -> Wu RMSE is 4.7x WORSE than baseline, hr=0. FAILURE MODE: the residual-refinement OUTER LOOP (forward-project the aliasing-free FBP, subtract, feature-preserving-interp the residual to 2x angles, FBP + soft-threshold + add-back) is INJECTING artefacts, not recovering aliasing structure -- on dense 128-view breast data the view-aliasing is mild so the densified residual is mostly error. ONE KNOB: wu_n_outer 2 -> 0 (skips the entire outer loop; returns the pure aliasing-free band-split FBP alone, 0 params). All else = iter-1. HYPOTHESIS: if I remove the residual add-back loop I expect val hr to rise above 0 (RMSE to drop toward/below the 0.00521 baseline) because the band-split aliasing-free FBP alone avoids the mis-estimated residual densification; if the band-split FBP alone still trails plain-FBP baseline, the band-splitting itself (not just the residual loop) is the problem and iter-3 sweeps n_bands. Budget: ~4s recon, trivially <20min.
